description: What a Smelter's reconcile came to (SMELTER.md § Reconcile), as its health reports a pass that is done (SmelterHealth's `reconcile.summary`). The first four add up to how many resources it set out to index, less any whose indexing was no longer wanted when its turn came.

resourcesEmbedded.description: How many resources it set out to index were indexed.

resourcesSkipped.description: How many were skipped, by the reason each was skipped for: a reason `smelt:settled` carries (SmeltSettled).

resourcesUnavailable.description: How many could not be read.

resourcesRestamped.description: How many resources it planned to rewrite the entity types of.

resourcesReanchored.description: How many resources it planned to derive the anchored text of again.

resourceVectorsDeleted.description: How many resources it planned to take out of the index.

annotationsEmbedded.description: How many annotations it planned to index.

annotationsRestamped.description: How many annotations it planned to rewrite the entity types of.

annotationVectorsDeleted.description: How many annotations it planned to take out of the index.

resourcesEligible.description: How many resources of the catalog have text.

resourcesIndexed.description: How many resources have points when it ends.
